data: Great game, beautiful graphics, great soundtrack
Great graphics, great gameplay, and fun all around
Amazing game, with amazing updates, I highly recommend to anybody that enjoyed Satisfatory or Factorio
Very immersive, very fun base building game that's easy to pick up, and keeps you hooked to the end game and past that
It is a fun engaging and challenging take on the Factory building game I really like the 3D nature and it brings new complexity
Way too much busy work, blueprints suck, just broken
The worst part is it's apparently been a known issue for a while and the developer has yet to address the issue

Incredibly fun and well polished for a recently "released" early access game. There is a ton of depth already present, lots of goals to work toward, and as you learn more about the game you'll find yourself addicted to optimizing your production process. And wow can it become a tangled web quickly.

Of course, it's not perfect, but I have very few complaints. Performance is perfectly smooth (capped at 100 fps), and I haven't had a single crash yet. There are definitely some QOL improvements that can be made but they're not worth griping over yet. I've seen some complaints about the translation and sure, there are some oddities here and there, but it's not like you can't understand what is being said.

Overall this is early access done right, folks. Well worth the asking price as it sits now and that makes me even more excited to see what's to come!

*UPDATE* HELP! I can't get out! It just keeps getting better,,,

I enjoy factory games and the satisfaction of building something and watching it work, and the scale that you can watch your creations operate on is truly mind-blowing in Dyson Sphere program. The music is beautiful as well, as are the visuals (GORGEOUS game), and the experience of being able to look at the scope of everything with the atmosphere it provides is extremely evocative for me. Sometimes I just fly around and look at what I've spent hours creating as the music swells, drinking in the majesty and the awe that it makes me feel. It's an experience I've never had in any other game before this one.

Dyson Sphere Program is one of a kind. If you like this genre of game even just casually, ABSOLUTELY check it out if you've got the hours to spare. It is an absolutely beautiful game that has taken my breath away on multiple occasions, and I'd want for anyone to be able to experience that themselves.

My first factory sim and I didn't get all that far but I had fun. Great visuals. It's very satisfying to have a global view of your planet and watch your conveyor belts stretch across the entire surface.

Oh wow I love this game. Definitely one of the best factory games up there with factorio. The fact that interstellar travel is seamless and intuitive is amazing. Definitely got stuck light years between stars with no fuel but it just immersed me even more. I can't even express how much I love the building too, how it warps to the equator or the poles and how I can manually raise and lower belts. I now have a belt 20 units in the air spanning half a planet to transport graphene and I love it. Maybe one of the only cons would be the dark fog since I'm not one to enjoy defending my factory from threats and I'd prefer more focus on developing the factory elements, but I still understand it and have started a new save to test it out. The graphics and stunning and the only performance issues I may have is slight lag when arriving or travel around a fully covered factory planet. Watching my Dyson sphere grow and flying through it is amazing and it's a game that really lets you feel your progress. Definitely recommend it and will keep playing for longer.

For an early access title, this game is amazing
If you like Factorio or Satisfactory you will like this
+Looks beautiful
+Engaging crafting/logistics puzzle
+Good performance overall (there is some popping only when you enter a planet)
+Relaxing feel/vibe

-Endgame feels a bit bland and not as deep as early game. I'm talking about the main quest ending almost as soon as you unlock the Universe Matrix, granted it's early access so there might be more coming

Really looking forward for the final release!
9.5/10

Land. Build. automate. Build more. automate MORE. INDUSTRIALIZE MORE!! 

I think you can see why I like this game. I love the visuals and the idea of interstellar factories. The mid-game can be boring but I think the creation system will fix that soon. Would recommend :D

Sure, why not make Factorio on a grander scale, amazing interface, spectacular graphics and a fantastic theme.

It's not like I had other plans for 2021 anyway.

Wow, this game is good.

In short, I really enjoy this game a lot. It's the only one that hit that Factorio vibe for me so extraordinarily well, that I've lately been struggling to choose which one of them to play in the little spare time I have.
I don't need no triple or "quadruple" A gaming industry now, I got amazing small Indie dev teams who pour their pashion and love into their beloved projects which ultimately overflow with style and thought way more than any game for "modern audiences" ever could.

Back to the game though, it's great, just like its inspiration it's a very customizable experience on a truly galactic scale. The milestones you will reach and leave behind are all memorable and very much enjoyable. From the very first lift-off, through the first interplanetary chain of transport to (hopefully one day) your first Dyson Sphere. It showcases the potential of what we humans are capable of achieving one day.

非常感谢您们，发展团队。戴森球对我来说超级好，特别难忘。多亏戴森球这个游戏我原来决定要学习汉语。差不多两年半从那时到现在，这个经验对我来说又有趣又利益。祝您们好运。

Absolute master piece of a game. A massive congratulations to the dev team, who really brought a marvel into the gaming community for people to enjoy!

I'm not going to lie, when I play this game hours turn into minutes - I genuinely cannot believe how fast the time passes once I sit down and start playing. It's super captivating, challenging and visually stunning! There are plenty of goals to aim for in the game and an infinite amount that you can set for yourself.

Overwhelmingly Positive since day zero? Check.
Devs who listen to their community? Check.
Nicely prepared and honestly amazing Soundtrack? Check!
Optimization for almost any kind of machine to play on? CHEEECK!

Should I say more or are you finally going to play this? (check :p)
Extremely polished, fluid gameplay, fun progression, recently added PvE elements, cool seting, good graphics and a soundtrack to match it. Highly recommended position for all enjoyers of the genre.

I like this game. I hate this game.

It went from being interesting, then overwhelming, then kinda fun.... And then it just got really annoying. OK You know a strategy game and a grand-strategy game? This is like a grand-building game. There is so.... much... crap. There is so.... much crap... I can say that over and over and you STILL would not understand.

And then they added in enemies and defenses and ammunition for your mech and its even MORE to try and manage. As I said I like this game. And I want to love it. But i'm growing to hate it so much more as time passes.
Very fun and challenge game, I love it and waiting for the combat system, will be amazing.

Amazing game. Really good out of the box building mechanics, logistics is very fun, graphics are really good and the game is really optimised, runs like a charm.

Have played Satisfactory before and loved that too, so wanted to check this one out. I think the way the game is structured (how you view the world from top rather than first person view) overall suits these types of games better, although Satisfactory had a different feel to it. People find it comparable to Factorio too.

If you like those types of games where you build a factory and continuously grow, you will definitely like this one too

Very well designed, and a hidden gem. I won't waste time reviewing everything that is good about this game, since others have captured that so well already.

The one thing i noticed after playing, I have about 70 hours in as of this review, is it strains my eyes really bad.

I have played games my whole life, and this is the first game I actually had to stop playing because it was causing pain in my eye. It honestly felt like a pulled a muscle in my eye. After a few weeks of not playing my eye feels back to normal.

I still recommend the game, but if you notice your eyes start to hurt know that it may be the game. I think it has to do with the zooming in and out all the time and constant camera angle shifting, mixed with tier three conveyor belts... It's a lot to take in.

Multiplayer with the abilty to host our own dedicated server (like factorio) would make this the best of the factory automation builders IMO. The scale you could achieve with some homies would be next level.

Still, god tier game
fantastic game, great graphics, processes, how you play, it has all been thought out... only waiting on multiplayer and then this will be perfecto!
Excellent Factorio-in-space game. Early access but very rich in features. Looking forward to seeing the ongoing improvement of this already highly entertaining game.

Lots to learn, lots to keep you occupied. Reminds me of the first time I played SC .. but much much more to it!
update: Never finished it. The late game is long and feels like a timesink != gaming

Space +
Automation +
Progression Trees +
Achievements +
Fully Customizable Avatar +
Time Sink that leads to mid-life crisis ++

Intermediates are significantly less complicated than Factorio. Scale starts at a way high level than factorio, lower top end due to brainless logistics. Has a much stronger incentive to continue past reaching last science. Has a mod that adds however real of a scale to the galaxy you want (GalacticScale its awful and horribly unfun but if you like the space part of space go nuts.)
If you like the terraforming and environmental exploitation of Factorio but the ratio's and numbers lining up and making sense and being workable makes you seethe with rage come play chinese solar system exploitation simulator, I promise you will eventually give up on your 1:8.2 ratios and just throw everything in ILS's. Plus petrochem is way more shrimple and you eventually research out of using anything but light oil and light oil cracking so that's nice, plus no fluid sim everything is a gubbins.

i like it, it's hours on hours of content, not that expensive and really fun. the only thing missing really is the cloud saves if you have multiple devices (but the export/ import seems to be possible, so i don't really get why no cloud save exists...) also for those who are afraid their computer will crash because you're building thousands of structures on hundreds of planets, i didn't have a problem on 7 year old hardware (didn't test after the dark fog update tho)
Very fun strategic farming and progression. For early access this game is amazing no bugs runs smooth as butter and keeps you busy for ages amazing value for money

For an early access game this game is more polished than many Triple-A games. The amount of quality of life improvements that have been published is amazing. The whole dyson-sphere-team has done a great job of creating a stellar game.

its a good game, but the translations could use some work, and the game needs more of an end game, like the ability to build a ring world or some other mega stucture that uses the power of one or more spheres

out of every factory game i have this one is the best by far and runs well
10/10 amazing job
this game can be a bit tedious at the start (like most factory games), but if you stick with it, it is a very rewarding experience!

I haven't played games like factorio or satisfactory before, and this is my first experience with the genre.

Right now, right after the early access launch the game is looking really good. The game looks and runs great. I have encountered ZERO bugs in almost 50 hours and while the game is not content complete, it seems to be close.

Basically a 3d multi-planet Factorio clone, but a very good one. There's some nice quality of life features, and the early game is really smooth. The only problems I can see are in the *atrocious* English translations, and it could be a lot more clear how to make items. The tech tree is a mess, it's very flat and hard to find what you're looking for, but gets the job done. I like the upgrade features.

This game is amazing.
It stands shoulder to shoulder with Factorio and Satisfactory.

There is a crazy sense of wonder when you send out the beginning of your first Dyson Sphere.
I spent 20 minutes just watching as the solar sails were sent into space forming my first Dyson Sphere. It was honestly one of the most satisfying moments I have had in gaming.

As a big fan of factory/automation games, I couldn't ignore this one and the overwhelmingly positive reviews...but my god, this software is just a nightmare to engage with. After configuring the UI to make it readable, it often remains indecipherable. Placing buildings/conveyers/sorters is so finicky and unintuitive, I couldn't believe it. With the existence of Satisfactory, StarRupture, and Factorio, I would only recommend this game to a factory fiend that already has hundreds of hours in those games.

Wow. If you're looking for a resource management game stop here and buy this game. I've played hundreds of hours of Factorio and hundreds of hours of Satisfactory - after only 6 hours (which passed incredibly quickly) Dyson Sphere Program has quickly become my favorite of the three. Don't get my wrong, both of those are incredible games but this game is on another level, especially if you're focus is on resource management. The scale of this game is incredible, the attention to detail is amazing.

I'd call this single player Factorio-lite in 3D. You easily fall down the logistics-solving-time-wormhole with this one, trying to make throughputs efficient. Then the added complexity of research and the actual namesake, the Dyson-related goodies... It's solid so far. The voice work is a bit strange, definitely needs some work, but for the most part everything is quite clear. Throw multiplayer/mods on this bad boy and this game could rival Factorio/Satisfactory in my book. Highly recommend.

Note: You can stack Research facilities and storage containers/tanks. Also up/down arrows to lift/lower conveyors. Didn't know this until 20+ hours in, little late for me. Hope it can help someone else!

I loved the game already, but since the new update, DSP feels like a whole new game. New challenge, new game objective, the whole narrative feels different, like you're fighting for control of the galaxy against an AI that will never stop consuming.

The joy of buying an early access game like this is that you feel like you got multiple games for the price of one , and the studio has my utmost respect for putting all their effort into updates like these that take the game to another level.

Good game, its fun too see big factories on small planets or to cover most of sun in dyson sphere. My biggest issues are planets that are too small, interplanetary logistic is unlocked way too late and dark fog is just terrible and boring enemy to fight against. Ah its also very annoying thing, due to planet grid, some thing might not exactly align and be offset 1 block in some direction. Ow and distance units are taken out of ass.
Great game where I encountered I think one bug the entire time playing it. The game is worth full price. Be warned, you can easily lose an hour or 2 playing this game and not realize it

Being a big fan of Satisfactory I was looking for something perhaps more challenging and this hits right up my alley. I explained it best to a friend as Factorio + Satisfactory on an Elite Dangerous scale. I know combat is coming, but right now I'm enjoying a game where you can play at your own pace.
It's Factorio meets Satisfactory with interstellar travel and more addictive than you would think (which should be a lot if you played either of those)

I've had this game for two days. I started the game at 2pm, and I looked up 3 minutes later to see that it was 5pm. Today, I started at 11am and about 30 minutes later it was 10pm. This game is ASTRONOMICALLY good at eating up time, and it's worth every minute. I think that in a month I will be 400 hours in and stil have another 6000 left to go. Great game, love it, would recommend.
I put 160 hours into this game in almost exactly 3 weeks. This game consumed my life. There is just always one more thing to do, one more thing to work on.

I like to think of this game as in the genre of "spaghetti factories", and in that category it stands strongly among the greats. It executes the tropes well, and adds plenty into it to give it a unique character all its own. Factory building is challenging and satisfying. The scope of the game and its graphics make it, frankly, strangely beautiful. Staring over the horizon of a planet at your dyson sphere as its built, flying over your factory world with the belts, machines and sorters blinking away in the darkness, there's really nothing like it.

Great game. Might be Early Access but you wouldn't know it. Currently spent almost 500 hours in and keep coming back to it. For fans of Factorio, etc, you will love this. Its the only factory game I play with enemies on, as they add real value in form of resources, early and late game. It gives me the feeling of 'I just need to do this one thing'... much like the 'one more turn' you get from other games. Love it.

This game is beautiful with good logistics mechanics, and game breaking soft locks.

Fuck this game.

Bought the Game... Didn´t like it...
Looked into it again after a Year and now im Addicted. I Love it. Can only recommend it to people how like Satisfactory or Factory etc.
great game for people who love logistics or space. Makes the PC run a little hot but nothing to worry about

I gotta say, there's not much more cool a sight than looking up from the planet you're on and seeing a star slowly getting a Dyson Sphere built around it. Youthcat did a real good job at the long range visuals.

Has a difficult learning curve once your planet is covered in spaghetti belts, if you get stuck I recommend looking up some blueprints online which you can import to use which help you progress when stuck. You can play this with dark fog off and have a chill factory builder game. Dark fog adds from PVE enemies to defend against.

Interplanetary factory builder with near limitless potential. Harness the energy of a star, or stars, to build small to large scale systems from conveyor belts to full on logistic drones travelling lights years in the blink of an eye. What does the drone carry? The resources you chose it to bring back from your super cool planetary workshop ACROSS THE GALAXY. Stars are nothing but a fuel source, and its your job to nab it.
This is the most fun and interesting game I've ever played. 10/10. It's worth playing.
It's very grind-y, and the lack of cloud saves is a problem if you're playing on more than one system (just lost several days of progress).

tldr.text: Overwhelmingly Positive (96%): players praise the graphics and art and the gameplay and combat.
Bugs and crashes draw the most complaints, and some players say known issues have stayed unfixed for a while.

details.text: Recent reviews are 93% positive, only slightly below the all-time score, so the overall mood has held steady.
Newcomers are much less positive, at 62%, than players with long playtimes, at 98%.
